issues.detail: All threads end with the exact same robotic roll-call of agreement from all participants (e.g., 'Aligned. I will...', 'Works for me. I will...', 'All good. I will...', 'Agreed. I will...'). The summarization messages also follow an identical structure across all threads ('Let me summarise... 1) ... 2) ... If no one objects...').
Thread TH4 has 18 messages, which is slightly below the blueprint target range of [22, 30].
